Dissecting CVE-2099-12345: template injection in AcmeDocs

In this post we walk through CVE-2099-12345, a template injection flaw in AcmeDocs 4.2.3 and earlier. The bug exists because the renderer does not sanitize the value of the X-Template-Hint header before evaluating it as an expression.

Setting up a lab

To reproduce this safely, use the intentionally vulnerable Docker image published by the AcmeDocs project. Do not test against systems you do not own.

docker run --rm -p 127.0.0.1:8080:8080 acmedocs/vulnerable:4.2.3

Steps to reproduce

  • Start the vulnerable container as shown above and wait for the log line "AcmeDocs ready".
  • Send a request to the preview endpoint with a crafted X-Template-Hint header.
curl -H 'X-Template-Hint: ${7*7}' http://127.0.0.1:8080/preview

If the server is vulnerable, the response body contains the number 49, which confirms the expression was evaluated. A patched server returns the header value unchanged.

Related More posts Subscribe

Impact

Because the expression language can reach the runtime, an attacker can escalate this into remote code execution as the service account.
